title: Here’s how to use intelligent dictation in Gemini for macOS.
text:
Here’s how to use intelligent dictation in Gemini for macOS.

Aug 25, 2026

We recently introduced a new way to create, edit, and summarize in the Gemini app for macOS using just your voice, right where you’re already working. This intelligent dictation feature allows you to speak naturally into any window on your desktop, transcribing your spoken words into clean, polished text. It automatically removes the “ums” and “ahs,” catches mid-sentence corrections, and drops the formatted text instantly at your cursor.See this feature in action — and learn how to turn it on — in the video below.
